overview.title.note: Page heading and document title for the overview route.

overview.date_today.note: Subtitle under Overview when the snapshot timestamp falls on the current local calendar day. Older snapshots show the date formatted for the Windows region instead.

overview.tasks_today.note: Heading above all seven task rows, including completed and skipped work.

overview.still_open.note: Label above measured remaining work, not a promised points award.

overview.open.cards.note: Remaining daily-set, misc-card and quest entries combined. count is numeric.

overview.open.search_points.note: Remaining measured search allowance. count is numeric points, not searches.

overview.open.searches_unknown.note: Part of the open-work list when today's search allowance is unknown.

overview.open.none.note: Only shown when a readable state from today measures no remaining cards or search points.

overview.task.search_progress.note: Open search row; earned and max are region-formatted search-points numbers.

overview.task.open_count.note: Count in a measured open daily-set, card or quest row. count is numeric.

overview.balance.note: Label above the large measured balance, which may be unavailable.

overview.points_unit.note: Unit below the balance number. Not money or a reward price.

overview.earned_today.note: Label beside points earned on the current local day.

overview.earned_value.note: Positive earned-today value; points is already formatted for the Windows region.

overview.next_check.note: Automatic schedule checks the Rewards page and may choose not to run.

overview.next_run.note: Fixed schedule label, distinct from automatic checking.

overview.check_around.note: Linked automatic check beyond tomorrow. time and date follow the Windows region; date omits the year unless it differs from the current year. Random delay makes the time approximate.

overview.check_around_today.note: Linked automatic check on the current local calendar day. time is formatted for the Windows region. Checking does not promise a run.

overview.check_around_tomorrow.note: Linked automatic check on the next local calendar day. time is formatted for the Windows region. Checking does not promise a run.

overview.run_at.note: Linked next fixed-time run. time and date are region-formatted.

overview.run_at_today.note: Linked fixed-time run on the current local calendar day. time is formatted for the Windows region.

overview.run_at_tomorrow.note: Linked fixed-time run on the next local calendar day. time is formatted for the Windows region.

overview.schedule.automatic.note: Schedule mode line. Do not imply a guaranteed run after each check.

overview.schedule.fixed.note: Schedule mode line for a fixed-time daily trigger.

overview.schedule.manual.note: Schedule mode line with no unattended schedule.

overview.schedule.manual_next.text: Only when you choose Run now
overview.schedule.manual_next.note: Next-time line for manual mode, above the separate Manual only mode label. No automatic run is planned.

overview.schedule.no_time.note: No next trigger timestamp is available for an automatic or fixed schedule.

overview.schedule.independent.text: Runs even when the app is closed
overview.schedule.independent.note: Only for an installed, in-sync and error-free Windows schedule.

overview.schedule.missing.text: The Windows schedule is missing. Open Settings and save the schedule to fix it.
overview.schedule.missing.note: Linked warning to Settings, Schedule when task_exists is false. Saving reinstalls the app's Windows task.

overview.schedule.out_of_sync.text: The Windows schedule is out of date. Open Settings and save the schedule to fix it.
overview.schedule.out_of_sync.note: Linked warning to Settings, Schedule when the task differs from the current settings. Saving updates it.

overview.schedule.error.text: The app could not read the Windows schedule. Open Settings to look at it.
overview.schedule.error.note: Linked warning to Settings, Schedule for a status-read failure. Do not show a raw error code.

overview.schedule.legacy.text: An older daily schedule is also installed. Review it in Settings.
overview.schedule.legacy.note: Linked notice to Settings, Schedule when legacy_task exists. No task is replaced by this link.

overview.run_now.note: Primary action starts the selected account and opens Live run.

overview.run_active.text: A run is in progress. Open Live run.
overview.run_active.note: Nearby reason for a disabled Run now button and a link to Live run.

overview.signin_active.text: Finish the sign-in window before starting a run.
overview.signin_active.note: Nearby reason for a disabled Run now button during sign-in.

overview.account_paused.text: This account is paused. Open Accounts to resume it.
overview.account_paused.note: Reason for disabling Run now for the selected paused account.

overview.run_signed_out.text: Sign in to this account before starting a run.
overview.run_signed_out.note: Reason beside disabled Run now when the selected account is signed out. An Open Accounts link follows.

overview.run_terms.text: Accept the new terms for this account before starting a run.
overview.run_terms.note: Reason beside disabled Run now when the account needs new Microsoft terms accepted. An Open Accounts link follows.

overview.account.note: Accessible label of the account switcher, shown only for multiple accounts.

overview.accounts.note: Recovery action for sign-out, terms or missing accounts.

overview.goal.saving.note: Polite waiting state while set_goal is pending.

overview.chart.title.note: Heading for the full-width 30-day history chart.

overview.chart.mode.note: Accessible label for balance versus earned-points radio choices.

overview.streaks.title.note: Overview card for Microsoft's captured Rewards streaks, separate from the app's own Stats streak.

overview.streaks.big_bonus.note: Heading above the captured bonus points and stamp grid. Do not imply the bonus has been earned.

overview.streaks.bing_search.note: Microsoft Rewards Bing Search streak name. The other rows reuse Daily set and Visual search task names. Bing App is deliberately not displayed.

overview.streaks.stamps_progress.note: Only when the captured number of collected stamps and the total are both known. Both values are region-formatted.

overview.streaks.stamps_total.note: Microsoft's stated stamp requirement when the collected count is unknown. count is numeric. Empty stamp outlines do not claim zero collected.

overview.streaks.stamps_collected.note: Known collected stamp count when the total was not captured. count is numeric; no grid or invented total is shown.

overview.streaks.day_of.note: Visible and accessible label of a streak's short step track. Values are region-formatted; day is the completed day, not a forecast.

overview.streaks.day.note: Captured streak day when its cycle length is unknown. day is region-formatted; no track is drawn without a length.

overview.streaks.today.note: Today's completed activity or search count, only when both numbers are known and the capture is from today in local time. Both values are region-formatted.

overview.streaks.next.note: Next day's reward stated by Microsoft, not a promise that the app will earn it. count is numeric points.

overview.streaks.as_of.note: One quiet line for a streak capture or a known balance reading's local date and time, both region-formatted. On Overview before today's figures are known, the balance uses the timestamp of its reading. The date remains visible for an older capture or reading.

overview.first_run.title.note: Empty-state heading before any recorded run or measurement.

overview.first_run.body.text: Choose Run now to see your points and what is open. Your tasks will appear here.
overview.first_run.body.note: First-run explanation. Unknown values stay unknown until measured.

overview.stale.text: Last checked on {date} at {time}. Today's points and open tasks are not known yet.
overview.stale.note: Stale measurement notice; date and time are the last state's region-formatted timestamp.

overview.load.title.text: Your overview could not be read
overview.load.title.note: No OverviewData is available after a failed initial request.

overview.load.body.text: Try again to load your points and tasks.
overview.load.body.note: Recovery guidance when OverviewData is missing.

overview.no_accounts.title.text: Add an account to get started
overview.no_accounts.title.note: Defensive empty-state heading if no account remains after setup.

overview.no_accounts.body.text: Open Accounts to connect your Microsoft account.
overview.no_accounts.body.note: Recovery guidance without opening a Microsoft page directly.

overview.synthetic.note: Visible mock-mode label. These points, accounts and outcomes are made up.
